children.text: INTERNSHIPS
A head start on shaping the future of defense

Interning at Anduril means having the autonomy to execute projects that have real, material impact with a mission-driven team. Anduril interns receive competitive compensation, mentorship, robust summer programming, and the potential opportunity to join the team full-time. If you're interested in Internship opportunities at Anduril, apply below.

image.alt: An Anduril summer intern wearing a 'Flight Test' shirt and safety helmet operates a remote controller during an outdoor UAV flight test in a desert environment, collaborating hands-on with defense technology as part of the company's internship program.

children.text: Anduril provides relocation support to interns that are not local to their internship office.

children.text: Work hard, but look cool while doing it! Each intern gets their own swag credit during their time here so you can rock Anduril anywhere you go.

EARLY CAREER
Work that matters

Join the most innovative minds of your generation to build autonomous systems that defend our nation and allies while working on advanced technology that is years ahead of the competition. If you’re interested in doing important work, apply above.

image.alt: "An Anduril early career engineer in a branded jacket watches an autonomous drone take flight over an open desert test range, representing the next generation of American defense innovators pushing the boundaries of autonomous systems technology.

children.text:
Our emerging talent recruitment effort designed to attract, develop, and retain top early career talent across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Manufacturing Engineering.

To differentiate Anduril, has launched a weeks long bootcamp to allow us provide the next generation of engineers with the mindset, exposure, and capabilities needed to build durable, production-ready systems from day one. Bootcamp provides a focused path to develop full-time early-career engineers and allow them to quickly integrate into their roles.

Currently, we have two bootcamp tracks - one for Software Engineering and one for Hardware Engineering roles. Please connect with your recruiter to learn more.

items.title: Engineering Bootcamp

children.text: Anduril has designed both a buddy and mentor program to foster professional development, accelerate career growth, and facilitate knowledge transfer by connecting our early career talent with seasoned professionals in their field. The goal is to provide a structured, supportive environment for skill building, boosting confidence, and enhancing performance through personalized guidance and networking.

items.title: Mentor & Buddy Programs

children.text: To set our early talent up for success, Anduril provides an array of options for our hires to ensure they are developing their foundational “soft“ skills when they join. We also offer an annual stipend to use for continuing education courses, programs, conferences or certification tests.

slices.headline: Casting the Next Generation of American Engineers
slices.subheadline: FIND YOUR NEXT MISSION AT ANDURIL

children.text: Internships:

These are intensive, 12-week programs for students currently pursuing a degree. You'll directly contribute to critical projects, experience our mission firsthand, and prove your capabilities in a fast-paced environment. It's a high impact immersion, often serving as a direct pipeline to full-time roles.
Early Career Opportunities:

These are full-time, permanent roles for recent graduates (typically 0-2 years post-graduation) ready to immediately take ownership, drive projects, and make sustained, long-term contributions to Anduril's mission. You'll be deeply integrated into our teams, with significant responsibility from day one.

items.title: What is the difference between an internship and an early career opportunity?

children.text: At Anduril, we're building the future of defense, and that requires an extraordinary array of talent. You'll find opportunities across many engineering disciplines like
Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Aerospace

.

We also value talent in business functions such as
Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, and Design.

These core profiles have been crucial to our growth, but as we rapidly scale, our talent needs continuously evolve and broaden. So, if you don't see your exact field listed, keep an eye out – we're always expanding!

items.title: What type of opportunities are available?

children.text: Our footprint is growing as rapidly as our mission! You might find intern and early career opportunities at our key locations:
Costa Mesa, CA
Atlanta, GA
Boston, MA
Quincy, MA
Columbus, OH
Washington D.C.
Reston, VA
Raleigh, NC
Seattle, WA
Keep in mind that specific openings and locations can vary by season and our evolving operational needs. Always check our live postings for the most current opportunities.

items.title: Which locations hire interns and early career?

children.text: Our internships are an intense,
12 week immersive experience.

We expect our interns to work full time, tackling real challenges and making meaningful contributions.

Our start dates are structured to accommodate academic calendars, running from
May-August or June-September
. This ensures you can integrate seamlessly and hit the ground running.

items.title: How long are internships and when do they start?

children.text: While we don't enforce a hard minimum GPA, we typically see strong candidates with a
cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

We understand that academic performance is one indicator, but we place significant weight on demonstrated technical ability, drive, real-world impact, and a relentless commitment to solving complex problems.

items.title: Is there a minimum GPA to apply for an internship?

children.text:
Absolutely.

We actively seek out and value the advanced research and deep expertise that Master's and Ph.D candidates bring to the table. Our intern classes often include a significant number of graduate students.

For Ph.Ds, we frequently have specialized research or high-impact project opportunities tailored to your advanced studies. Always check our careers page for the most current and relevant openings.

items.title: Can students pursuing their Master's or Ph.D degree be eligible for internship opportunities?

children.text:
Due to the sensitive nature of our work in national security and our strict adherence to U.S. government regulations, including ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations), Anduril is currently unable to provide employment sponsorship for F-1 Visa students.

To be eligible for opportunities with us, you must be a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

items.title: Does Anduril provide Employment sponsorship for F-1 Visa students?

children.text: Your resume is your opportunity to powerfully convey your capabilities and potential impact at Anduril. Make it compelling by including:
Clear Contact Information:
Ensure we can easily reach you.
Academic Foundations:
University, major(s), and your GPA.
Demonstrated Experience:
Highlight internships, significant projects, research, or prior job experience where you made a difference.
Project Leadership & Impact:
Detail your most impactful projects, your specific role, and the outcomes. Show us what you built and why it mattered.
Technical Mastery:
List the languages, software, tools, and platforms you're proficient in.
Quantifiable Impact:
Whenever possible, use numbers and metrics to showcase the scale and success of your contributions.

items.title: What should I include on my resume?

children.text: We're seeking individuals who are not just skilled, but driven to redefine national security. We look for:
Proven Impact:
Demonstrated excellence through projects, previous internships, or research where you delivered tangible results.
Insatiable Curiosity:
A deep desire to learn, adapt, and push the boundaries of what's possible.
Unshakeable Initiative:
The ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion without constant oversight.
Collaborative Drive:
A team-first mindset, understanding that our mission is too critical to tackle alone.
Unwavering Mission Alignment:
A genuine passion for Anduril's vision and a desire to contribute to national security.

items.title: What qualities is Anduril looking for in an early career candidate?

children.text: We are building technology to solve some of the hardest problems in national security, and we’re incredibly grateful that thousands of brilliant students want to join us in that mission.

We review applications on a rolling basis. Because we receive tens of thousands of submissions each cycle, our team focuses on moving as quickly as possible. While we would love to give a personal update to everyone who applies, our team’s capacity means that isn't always possible.
If there’s a potential fit:
A member of our recruiting team will reach out directly to outline next steps and get to know you.
If you don’t hear from us:

It means we have decided to move forward with other candidates for this specific cohort. Please don’t let this be the end of the road, our hiring needs change rapidly, and we highly encourage you to keep building your skills and apply again in the future.

items.title: When can I expect to hear back about my application?

children.text: Our interview process is designed to be rigorous, transparent, and a true test of your capabilities. It's a deep dive into your technical prowess, problem-solving approach, and how you align with Anduril's mission. You can expect:
Recruiter Call:
To discuss your background and ambitions.
Technical and Behavioral Interviews:
Expect challenging questions designed to assess your skills, critical thinking, and how you navigate complex situations.
Role specific assessments:

This could include live coding challenges, presentations, or in depth technical discussions, depending on the team and role.
Throughout, we’re looking for evidence of your problem solving abilities and your commitment to our mission. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance every step of the way.

items.title: What does the interview process look like?

children.text: We believe in empowering our talent from day one. Our team placement process is strategic and tailored: we deeply consider your past project experience, technical capabilities, problem-solving skills, and areas of interest. This allows us to make a precise match, ensuring your skills make a direct and immediate impact on critical projects and that you thrive in an environment that leverages your unique strengths.
